title: Activities
subtitle: Activities of {{record}}
viewAllSoon: The activities page comes in a later step

empty.title: Nothing is planned yet
empty.text: Plan the next call, meeting or visit for this record.

hints.type: Choose the kind of activity to show the matching schedule, location, link, or direction fields.
hints.subject: Enter a short summary of the activity (up to 180 characters) shown in lists and reminders.
hints.assignee: Select the team member responsible for completing this activity and receiving its reminder.
hints.due: Pick the date and 24-hour time when this activity is due; drives overdue and today badges.
hints.start: Pick the start date and 24-hour time for this activity; shifting it preserves the duration.
hints.reminder: Choose when to notify the assignee before the scheduled time, or turn the reminder off.
hints.end: Optional end date, 24-hour time, or duration preset (up to 14 days after the start).
hints.status: Set whether the new activity is scheduled for later, already in progress, or logged as completed.
hints.priority: Select the urgency level; high and urgent activities display a priority badge on cards.
hints.direction: Indicate whether the call or email was inbound, outbound, or internal to your team.
hints.location: Enter the address, branch, or meeting room (up to 180 characters) where the activity takes place.
hints.meetingUrl: Paste a full meeting link starting with http:// or https:// to show a quick join button.
hints.description: Add preparation notes, talking points, or agenda details (up to 4,000 characters).
hints.outcome: Record what happened and the agreed next steps for this completed activity (up to 2,000 characters).
hints.completeOutcome: Optional summary of the result or next steps (up to 2,000 characters) saved when marking as done.
hints.cancelReason: Optional reason for cancelling this activity (up to 2,000 characters) saved in the record history.

complete.title: Complete this activity
complete.templateLeftMessage: Left a message, waiting for a reply

conflict.title: This activity was changed
conflict.text: Someone else changed this activity. Reload it, or keep your changes and save over it.

discard.title: Discard your changes?
discard.text: Your changes to this activity are not saved.

validation.startInPast: A scheduled activity must start in the future.
validation.doneInFuture: A completed activity cannot start in the future.
validation.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
validation.endTooLong: An activity can last at most {{days}} days.
validation.invalidUrl: Enter a full link that starts with http:// or https://.

errors.ACTIVITY_INVALID: Check the activity details and try again
errors.ACTIVITY_VERSION_CONFLICT: This activity was changed by someone else
errors.ACTIVITY_TERMINAL: A completed or cancelled activity cannot be changed
errors.ACTIVITY_ACCESS_DENIED: You do not have permission for this activity
errors.ACTIVITY_VERSION_REQUIRED: Reload the activity and try again
errors.ACTIVITY_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID: The request could not be repeated safely.
errors.ACTIVITY_IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH: The request could not be repeated safely.
errors.ACTIVITY_IDEMPOTENCY_IN_FLIGHT: This request is already being processed.
errors.ACTIVITY_TARGET_RESOLVER_UNAVAILABLE: The record's app is not responding right now.
errors.CORE_VALIDATION_FAILED: The submitted data is not valid.
errors.generic: The activity could not be saved
